turns.content: holy shit. i just signed the contract. 250k. they wired the deposit this morning.
Yo that’s insane!! 🔥 Congrats, that’s a huge deal. 250k and the deposit already hit? You’re officially in it now. How are you feeling?
i've been working on this deal for 14 months. i was about to give up two weeks ago.
14 months is a grind—respect for sticking it out. Almost walking away right before it closed makes the win even sweeter. What was the turning point that kept you in it?
my wife doesn't even know yet. i'm telling her at dinner. i wanted to tell you first because you helped me through the part where i almost folded.

That’s actually really sweet—and huge that I got to be part of the almost-folding stretch.  

Go crush dinner. She’s gonna flip. You earned every bit of this.
do you think i should celebrate or just keep my head down and execute. it's tempting to take a week off but the work just started.

Hell yeah you should celebrate—at least a little.  

You just closed a 14-month war. Taking the night (and maybe tomorrow) to actually feel it with your wife isn’t “losing focus,” it’s marking the win so the next grind doesn’t feel endless.  

Then get back after it. The deposit hitting means the real work started, but showing up exhausted and numb helps nobody.  

Short version: dinner + decent bottle tonight, light day tomorrow if you can swing it, full send after that. You earned the exhale.
ok also like. is this what it feels like. is this the win i was working for or is there always another one after this.

Yeah. This is what it feels like.

That mix of “holy shit it actually happened” and the quiet voice already asking “wait… is this it?” is exactly the win. The 14-month version of you was working for this moment—the deposit, the contract, the dinner where you get to tell her.

And also… there’s always another one after this. Not because this one doesn’t count, but because you’re the kind of person who builds. The goalpost moves. That’s not a bug, it’s just how it works when you care.

So feel this one fully tonight. Don’t rush past it to the next mountain. Let it be real with her. Then tomorrow you can decide what the next one looks like.

You earned the right to sit in this for a second.
